UI_PLB_Preset_Tooltip: Damage, accuracy and handling use the selected preset. The ranged-weapon penetration bonuses below apply independently in every preset.
UI_PLB_VanillaVolume_Tooltip: Changes only the vanilla gunshots heard through speakers or headphones. Zombie hearing distance is unchanged.
UI_PLB_BritaVolume_Tooltip: Changes only the Brita gunshots heard through speakers or headphones. Zombie hearing distance is unchanged.
UI_PLB_SuppressedVolume_Tooltip: Changes only the audible Brita suppressed gunshot volume. Suppressor zombie-attraction behavior is unchanged.
UI_PLB_CustomDamage_Tooltip: Multiplies original damage. Used only by the Custom preset.
UI_PLB_CustomHitBonus_Tooltip: Adds to original hit chance. Used only by the Custom preset.
UI_PLB_CustomCritBonus_Tooltip: Adds to original critical chance. Used only by the Custom preset.
UI_PLB_CustomAimTime_Tooltip: Lower values aim faster. Used only by the Custom preset.
UI_PLB_CustomRecoilDelay_Tooltip: Lower values allow faster follow-up shots. Used only by the Custom preset.
UI_PLB_CustomPenetration_Tooltip: Adds penetration targets to rifles, automatic long guns, and existing role weapons. Used only by the Custom preset.
UI_PLB_PenetrationClass_Tooltip: Adds 0-4 targets to original penetration in every preset, up to 8. Targets must be nearly in one straight line.
UI_PLB_Penetration_Handgun_Tooltip: Adds penetration targets to handguns and revolvers.
UI_PLB_Penetration_SMG_Tooltip: Adds penetration targets to submachine guns and PDWs.
UI_PLB_Penetration_Shotgun_Tooltip: Lets each pellet hit more nearly aligned targets.
UI_PLB_Penetration_Rifle_Tooltip: Adds penetration targets to rifles and assault rifles.
UI_PLB_Penetration_Sniper_Tooltip: Adds penetration targets to sniper rifles, DMRs, anti-materiel rifles and railguns.
UI_PLB_Penetration_MachineGun_Tooltip: Adds penetration targets to machine guns, LMGs and miniguns.
UI_PLB_Penetration_Bow_Tooltip: Lets arrows hit more nearly aligned targets.
UI_PLB_Penetration_Crossbow_Tooltip: Lets crossbow bolts hit more nearly aligned targets.
UI_PLB_Penetration_Slingshot_Tooltip: Lets slingshot ammunition hit more nearly aligned targets.
